title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of major jackpot draws on September 16, 2026
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on September 16, 2026, as the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot is now over P202 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said…

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on September 16, 2026, as the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot is now over P202 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Wednesday.
No bettor picked the winning combination of 04-07-08-54-51-31 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of P202,471,705.43.
According to PCSO, the odds of winning the jackpot for the Grand Lotto 6/55 are 1 in 28,989,675. To win, bettors must match all six numbers chosen from a field of 1 to 55.
For Megalotto 6/45, there were also no one who chose the winning combination of 24-28-31-12-04-32 for the P58,995,759.32 windfall.
Visit here for the complete lotto results. —RF, GMA News
